capabilities: Create notes from templates with filled-in names, folders, and properties
Capture text into existing notes without opening them
Run macro chains of choices, Obsidian commands, scripts, and AI prompts
Collect inputs with forms using dropdowns, date pickers, and sliders
Trigger choices from obsidian:// links, Apple Shortcuts, and the Obsidian CLI
disambiguation: Not just quick note creation; it also runs multi-step macros, forms, scripts, and AI prompts.
extras: AI features stay off until enabled; the Obsidian CLI is desktop-only; docs live on an external site; author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no unified way to trigger capture, note creation, and multi-step routines with a single hotkey or command.

relations.evidence: Using Templater? Add your template folder in QuickAdd's settings
send prompts to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible provider

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key

summary: Workflow builder that creates notes from templates, captures text into notes, and runs multi-step macros from hotkeys or commands.
